milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the purple wall banner (placed at spawn-relative 5, 2, 4 on the west face of the stone brick building) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=5 ensures the agent is genuinely close enough to identify the banner (not just glancing from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms intentional observation direction.
